title: FerkoCraft
description: A fun mod that you WILL enjoy, with friends:), and also if you want build a nuclear reactor:)
body:
## What is this modpack about?
This modpack ads a "fun" new entity Ferko(TOWW), that will stalk you... It will also add Mekanism so you can make jetpacks, atomic tools, Antimatter,fission reactor,and a lot more... You can also cook with the Farmers Delight mod and it's addons,~~ or cook drugs~~[not avalaible on  modrinth], it depends what you prefer. There is a mod that also adds Guns to minecraft(doesnt work on ferko). A nice furniture mod is also included so you can make your own preety house(with a fission reactor in the basement). 

### DISCLAIMER!!!
I am not responsible for any game crashes, Heart attacks, or exploded fissile reactors!!!
This modpack is NOT optimized (im too lazy)

Recomendations:
- You SHOULD play with friends! 
- You should atleast try to make a fissile reactor in your basement!
- Expldoe Ferko!
- And have fun!



 
Don't bother with reporting bugs. I don't care.  
![ferko](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/132cd985dab2424a0234d43946de1bad12b79cae.jpeg)
